name: @knowget/transport
description: Smart Mobility, Transport & Fleet Platform (P2-D16) — the institution's operational transport system of record: the vehicle fleet and drivers, routes and their stops, vehicle-to-route assignments, student transport subscriptions, trips run against routes, and vehicle compliance documents. A pure route-schedule engine computes stop ETAs and seat utilization; a pure trip-occupancy engine reconciles boarding/alighting against vehicle capacity. Money (transport fees, vehicle valuation, maintenance cost) is out of scope — deferred to Finance (P2-D14) and the Asset register (P2-D15).
